deliveryDecision.focusedMedia: Inspected character illustration + original selected style, two final-stage images; original photograph is used only for character preparation and conversation-side identity comparison.
deliveryDecision.otherMedia: Primary identity + original style + scoped selected-condition sheet when applicable.
deliveryDecision.individualSamples: Comparison material; not a recommendation to attach every image, and not accepted as a superior method.
deliveryDecision.allSelections: All ten selections remain in the plan, final-stage input and condition audit; omitted pictures do not omit the selected conditions.

acceptancePolicy: Check actual identity, medium-specific drawing process, light/shadow, clothing/material, pose/support, camera, selected format/copy, Halloween causality and output dimensions. A generated image alone is not a pass. Undersized, unavailable or failed stages are stated explicitly.
